DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The symptoms you describe—double vision that worsens with looking up or down, and weakness that improves with rest—are classic signs of Myasthenia Gravis. To confirm this, I need to see your acetylcholine receptor antibody test results.
